Test Ore

For other uses, see Test Ore (disambiguation).
Infobox noise

Infobox noise paragraph that must not appear.

Test ore is a block that drops one raw test when mined with a stone pickaxe or better.[1]

Spawning

[edit]

It generates between levels 16 and 96 in ordinary stone.

It is most common around level 48 and never appears in the deep dark.

On death

A test ore decoration drops two items.

History

This history paragraph must be dropped.

Development

This development paragraph must be dropped too.

Usage

Test ore can be smelted into a test ingot.

It can also be crafted into a block of test.
